LanguageData.DisableSteamMods_EnableWhitelistTooltip: When enabled, only Workshop mods with package IDs in the whitelist are allowed.
LanguageData.DisableSteamMods_EnableBlacklistTooltip: When enabled, Workshop mods with package IDs in the blacklist are blocked.
LanguageData.DisableSteamMods_RemoveOnlyLocalDuplicat: Only remove Workshop mods with a local version
When enabled, Workshop mods are only filtered out if a local mod with the same package ID exists in the local Mods folder.
LanguageData.DisableSteamMods_ModKeyHelp: Use comma, space, or newline separated RimWorld package IDs. One package ID per line is easiest to read. Wildcards are supported, for example nemuruyama.*. The default whitelist contains nemuruyama.disablesteammods and zetrith.prepatcher.
